reviews.title: Used to be good, now trying to get money out of you
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for several years. The free version had a lot of tools available to you, while others were locked behind a paywall, but it was never features that I had to have and I was happy to watch a few ads or miss a few things like fonts, frames, or filters. A year or two ago they locked away many of the previously free things behind their subscription. I immediately began to use it less than I did before, but from time to time I continued to use it. At the end of editing your picture, a very noticeable watermark appears that says “Created In Collageable.” You used to be able to remove it by watching an ad. For about the last month however, the option to watch an ad is there, but it never loads in so you can press it, meaning your only options are to keep the water mark or pay for their subscription. If they had simply removed the “watch ad” button and were honest about the choice to have the watermark or pay, I would respect it a bit more, but breaking to “watch ad” button, forcing you to wait for it to loads which it never will, until you hopefully cave in and pay them, is so shady.

reviews.title: No longer usable for basic collages
reviews.text: This has been my go-to app for years and years to make basic collages (think comparison pictures — not fancy pictures), but now with the updates / upgrades, it’s no longer usable for a nuts-and-bolts user. It’s so disappointing. I would gladly pay for just the basic app — not the extras (I’m not an influencer, and I’m not on social media) — just give me the option to choose my collage format and insert my pictures where I want them and save or do a screenshot. All this extra stuff to go through is just way too, well, extra. Sometimes new isn’t better.

reviews.title: Both Good and Terrible
reviews.text:
Pro: App is easy to use and has some remaining “free-ish” layouts, from custom to freestyle.
 4/5
Con: If you want to use the free version, watching ads is understandable to support the company and creators; however, please note the replies to other reviewers complaining about the ads is not correct: most ads are NOT AT ALL a few seconds. How nice it would be if they were. All too many are a minute or more or worse an “x” or arrow or any other way other than closing the entire app and losing your collage never appears. This needs addressing, as this creates unfortunate ill will towards the app and 100% towards whatever is being advertised. 
Worse Update: now a BASIC layout, no frills, is locked behind a demand to follow on Instagram. Shameful. 1/5

reviews.title: Extremely limited unless you pay.
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app about about a year ago and everything was fine.
This year I wanted to create a new collage and I discover that most features are behind a premium membership which is £10 a week which is absolutely crazy for a collage app. But once I finished my simple collage they seriously don’t let you download the image unless you follow them on social media?! No thanks. 
Incredibly scummy will be deleting this app and will find a better alternative.
